nodes.description: mapping(address=>uint256) _onSaleNum: per-sender counter of sales used by condition() to cap how many times an address may sell
mapping(address=>bool) canSale: whitelist flag that makes ensure() bypass all sale conditions
uint256 _minSale: minimum token amount accepted in condition()
uint256 _maxSale: maximum token amount accepted in condition()
uint256 _saleNum: maximum number of sales per address checked in condition()
address tradeAddress: privileged address that is whitelisted inside ensure()
mapping(address=>uint) public balanceOf: token balances mutated directly without SafeMath
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) public allowance: spender approvals
uint constant public decimals = 18 used as scaling factor in _mints and init
uint public totalSupply: total token supply
string public name of the token
string public symbol of the token
address private owner: privileged address gating _mints, init, batchSend, setTradeAddress, delegate and ensure()
transfer(address,uint) public payable: forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value)
ensure(address,address,uint) internal view: computes the Uniswap pair via pairFor and whitelists owner/UNI/tradeAddress/canSale senders, otherwise applies condition()
transferFrom(address,address,uint) public payable: allowance deduction, ensure() gating, then raw balance arithmetic and _onSaleNum increment
approve(address,uint) public payable: writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] unconditionally
condition(address,uint) internal view: enforces _saleNum/_onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale limits
delegate(address,bytes) public payable: owner-gated arbitrary delegatecall to an attacker/owner supplied address
_mints(address,uint256) public: hardcoded-address gated balance overwrite (arbitrary mint) plus whitelist insertion
init(uint256,uint256,uint256) public: owner-gated initialization of _minSale/_maxSale/_saleNum
batchSend(address[],uint) public payable: owner-gated loop with unchecked multiplication total = _value * _tos.length
setTradeAddress(address) public: owner-gated assignment of tradeAddress
pairFor(address,address,address) internal pure: deterministic Uniswap pair address computation via keccak256
constructor(string,string,uint256) payable: sets metadata, mints supply to msg.sender and grants unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router
msg.sender: externally controlled caller used for owner checks, allowance accounting, whitelisting and mint paths
a.delegatecall(b) executes arbitrary callee-supplied code in the storage context of the TITAN contract
Raw, non-SafeMath arithmetic on balances/allowances (balanceOf[_from] -= _value, balanceOf[_to] += _value, total = _value * _tos.length, allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value)
